composition.serve_who: This sheet details the primary 24V DC Service Supply distribution network. The drawing's title '24V DC SERVICE SUPPLY' and the central topology of high-voltage MAPS converters feeding a '+24V SERVICE BUS' and 'NEGATIVE BUS' demonstrate that this system acts as the main hub distributing 24V DC power to vital ship equipment, including main DC panels, bilge and fire pumps, and backup battery banks.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Labeled 'PORT MAPS-1/2 2x5KW' converting 600V DC to 24V DC.

functions.label: 600V DC to 24V DC Conversion
functions.what_it_does: Steps down high-voltage DC from the port HVPDU to supply the vessel's 24V DC service bus.

flow_scenarios.path: Power flows from PORT HVPDU 600V DC BUS via Q1/Q4 (32A breakers) and F1/F2 (500A fuses) into two 5KW converter units. The 24V DC output passes through F1/F2 (250A fuses) and a fused terminal, is monitored by CT1/CT2, and routes through isolator switches SW1/SW2 to the +24V SERVICE BUS.

functions.label: Service Network Current Sensing
functions.what_it_does: Monitors the power output of the MAPS converters and key distribution lines.

flow_scenarios.path: Current transformers CT1, CT2, CT3, CT4 clamp onto the four MAPS 24V DC output lines; CT5 clamps onto the 230V AC converter's DC output; CT6 clamps onto the LV. BAE PANEL feed. All CTs send telemetry signals out 'to ONYX'.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The control module is labeled 'BEL-1/4 230V AC CONTROL' on a PC CARD.

functions.label: BEL AC Control Logic
functions.what_it_does: Provides control signaling and auxiliary power mapping for the BEL units.

flow_scenarios.path: The PC CARD interfaces through a 10-pin output block. Pin 8 (AUX) routes through the T/S E terminal strip, through a 6A breaker (QE7), and terminates at '+24V EMERGENCY POWER'. Pins 6, 7, and 9 route to NEG, BAE, and +EM respectively.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Voltage sensing tap labeled 'BAE VOLTAGE SENCE' and key switch 'BAE START KEY SW'.

functions.label: BAE Bus Voltage Sense
functions.what_it_does: Samples the primary FWD DC PANEL feed for BAE system voltage status.

flow_scenarios.path: The BAE VOLTAGE SENCE line taps into the FWD DC PANEL supply circuit via T/S S terminals 1-3 to monitor the primary 24V bus state.

facts: A central '+24V SERVICE BUS' consolidates incoming 24V DC power from PORT and STBD MAPS converters, a '24V 110A' AC/DC converter, and the Aux Service Battery.

The bus distributes primary load power outwards: feeding the FWD DC PANEL via a fused terminal on wire 70, SW6, and F5 (100A); and the AFT DC PANEL via a fused terminal on wire 95, SW7, and F6 (200A).
A centralized 'NEGATIVE BUS' acts as the common return path for the FWD/AFT DC PANELS, Bilge/Fire pumps, and the Gen/Aux/Emergency battery banks.
A standalone 230V AC to 24V DC 110A converter injects supplementary power into the service bus via an F18 (125A) fuse and the SW5 isolator.
